openclaw 2026.11.4
summary:
2026.11.4

Highlights

  • Large conversations: Keep large transcript trimming, paged memory exports, and Doctor repairs from exhausting worker memory. #194066, #196158, #196132, #195459, #196480 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, and @garrytan.
  • Large-store startup: Start plugins and their services before orphan scanning, and scan active recovery candidates without loading unrelated retained session summaries. #176737, #181289, #181090 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @oxen-horse.
  • Reliable replies: Preserve unanswered prompts across Gateway restarts, keep WhatsApp final replies across unrelated reloads, and prevent Signal reconnects from skipping buffered messages. #187157, #187143, #168778, #187667, #187665 Thanks @shakkernerd, @mcaxtr, @HermanZeng, and @obviyus.
  • Private conversation data: Keep Side chat scoped to its authenticated viewer, paired-node photos and screenshots private by default, and internal model prompt projections out of display output. #185390, #181215, #174814, #173460 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @eleqtrizit, and @obviyus.
  • Safer upgrades: Prevent a newer CLI from migrating a shared database beyond an older installed Gateway daemon while allowing unrelated installation databases to remain independent. #186971, #186898, #187819, #187870, #187886, #187878, #187966, #187937, #190194, #190177 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @tomdailey55, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, @shakkernerd, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
  • Safe Files saves: Reject stale editor saves after a workspace is replaced instead of overwriting files in the replacement workspace. #178336, #178310 Thanks @shakkernerd.

Changes

  • PostgreSQL durability: Honor the server’s synchronous_commit setting instead of forcing it off, while keeping port and backup transactions durable. #180821 Authored by @steipete.
  • Delegated administration: Require approval for persistent delegated changes without effective authority, support explicit global or per-agent standing policy, and recheck the grant at each persistent effect. #196984 Thanks @RomneyDa and @joshavant.
  • Input policy hooks: Expose prepared current-turn images to before_agent_run policy hooks ahead of model submission, using the same image bytes once approved. #196337 Thanks @joshavant.

Fixes

  • Diagnostics privacy: Redact multiline captured telemetry and identifying triage-map keys. #194353, #175272, #174680 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @mmaps and @thefourcraft.
  • Configuration boundaries: Reject reserved provider and MCP assignment keys, retain restrictive allowlists in Doctor, and respect disabled plugins whose IDs use mixed case. #191389, #190068, #188846, #188845 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @yetval, and @masatohoshino.
  • Doctor credentials: Do not import plaintext catalog credentials alongside stored SecretRefs. #179802 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ensignwesley.
  • Attachment authority: Reject queued attachments when the caller’s access is revoked and reject ambiguous capability-scoped request paths. #159106, #190863 Thanks @sallyom, @vincentkoc, and @arpe1618.
  • Sandbox protection: Protect nested skill mounts from writable ancestors, prepare missing protected sources on first launch, and resume turns after upgrade adds protected mounts. #180840, #182412, #94425, #182789 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @eleqtrizit, @momothemage, and @akang1798.
  • Private model and channel output: Scope Side chat by authenticated requester, keep paired-node capture output private by default, and prevent internal prompt projections from appearing in display output. #185390, #181215, #174814, #173460 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @eleqtrizit, and @obviyus.
  • Filesystem containment: Advance fs-safe containment protections to reject redirected-parent writes before producing content, including private staging paths. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Compaction privacy: Redact credential-shaped text in quoted compaction summary sections, leaving stored history unchanged. #197349 Thanks @obviyus.
  • Stored skill credentials: Refuse to replace SecretRef-backed or unrecognized API-key sources with plaintext when saving a skill key, and preserve pending Settings edits. #197319 Thanks @mmaps.
  • iOS pairing privacy: Stop persisting pasted setup codes on the device. #197049 Thanks @obviyus.
  • IRC sender policy: Treat an explicitly empty channel sender list as deny-all rather than falling back to broader sender access. #196293 Thanks @mmaps.
  • Approval recovery: Prefer canonical execution policy over conflicting retained legacy input during Gateway, node, and Doctor preparation. #196401 Authored by @steipete.
  • Confidentiality boundary repairs: Scope Tlon citation expansion to authenticated channel access, redact sensitive Gateway health diagnostics, and carry host-captured CLI requester identity into MCP policy checks. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @mmaps, and @alkor2000.
  • Execution authorization: Combine global and agent Claude CLI policy, keep host CLI cron out of sandboxed sessions, and require appropriate approval for recursive shell assignments and legacy arithmetic; keep Windows POSIX-shell payload approvals one-shot. Thanks @RomneyDa, @eleqtrizit, and @pgondhi987.
  • Child-process credentials: Keep active PostgreSQL credentials out of inherited child environments while retaining explicit user overrides. Thanks @RomneyDa and @galiniliev.
  • Live authority: Use current Gateway configuration for new native approvals, honor current authority through worker Stop, and recheck authority around off-catalog model discovery. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Draft conversation copies: Keep whole-conversation copies in Draft unless another audience is explicitly chosen, and recheck creation policy before committing the copy. #186828, #186771 Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • Restricted repository access: Limit restricted roles to public repositories on the configured GitHub endpoint and recheck visibility before new source handoffs, while preserving permitted agent-workspace access. #194830 Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Conversation memory: Bound large transcript trimming, sync-index work, paged session exports, and Doctor repairs; retain MEMORY.md if Doctor merges fail. #194066, #196158, #196132, #195459, #190497, #196480 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, @garrytan, and @syxscott.
  • Code Mode: Stop a cell after tool-reply decoding fails, complete rejected programs even with pending siblings, and let required-completion calls collect existing process results when suspension slots are full. #188023, #196435, #196927 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Database recovery: Recover from connection loss without leaving chats stuck, recognize writes that committed despite an uncertain worker result, and settle staged PostgreSQL transactions at physical commit. #181661, #177321, #193842 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Memory wiki: Reject special files during ingestion rather than blocking on them. #187621 Thanks @Leon-SK668 and @obviyus.
  • Restart recovery: Keep original unanswered prompts and accepted executions through restart capture, keep local final replies, and send an uncertainty notice if Telegram final recovery cannot confirm delivery. #187157, #187143, #187795, #195400 Thanks @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, @MertBasar0, and @jason-allen-oneal.
  • WhatsApp and Signal: Keep WhatsApp final replies from being suppressed by unrelated reloads and deliver Signal messages buffered across reconnects. #168778, #187667, #187665 Thanks @mcaxtr, @HermanZeng, and @obviyus.
  • Claude CLI: Drain initialization events so hook messages cannot deadlock startup, and avoid orphaning the OAuth refresh lock on login-check cancellation. #173011, #173002, #197032, #189214 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @sopa-gpters, @obviyus, and @kir1ll.
  • Native agent startup: Time out silent Agents API session initialization instead of leaving the turn waiting indefinitely. #196517 Authored by @steipete.
  • Provider setup: Keep selected Z.AI Coding Plan endpoints for supported models retained in the catalog, and prevent stale quota probe failures from overriding newer successful authentication. #195390, #176602 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jason-allen-oneal.
  • Gemini tool schemas: Omit enums on non-string schemas so Gemini and Vertex accept boolean tool parameters. #196742, #196717 Thanks @obviyus and @yixiaoer-520.
  • Plugin state and reloads: Admit plugin-state writes before taking the writer and bound config-only service restarts, and defer busy config reloads so they do not hang. #182117, #182331 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Cloud and workspace preparation: Exclude local SDK testing chunks from cloud worker bootstrap and avoid false unsaved-work errors when preparing a fresh guest PR. #181824, #185777, #185747 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • Service version skew: Bind migration protection to the installed service’s physical database, preserve active operations and authorized maintenance, and avoid blocking configuration or isolated Doctor work for an unrelated older service. #186971, #186898, #187819, #187870, #187886, #187878, #187966, #187937, #190194, #190177 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @tomdailey55, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, @shakkernerd, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
  • Upgrade recovery: Repair missing legacy canonical-login columns ahead of schema validation, keep accepted recovery baselines on truncated-config detection, and protect concurrent config edits during plugin finalization. #186529, #183731, #152565, #152509, #189819 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ausvald, @LiuwqGit, @RomneyDa, and @yetval.
  • Stable plugin updates: Keep official plugin selectors on the stable channel instead of repeatedly returning to beta. #194812, #194804 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @DonnieFi.
  • Install and update paths: Use a private update workspace when temporary-directory ancestors are unsafe, preserve literal private CLI paths containing shell characters, stop on Homebrew bootstrap failures, and launch Windows onboarding after npm-shim installation. #187737, #187657, #189541, #187688, #187678, #185309 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Yachiyo1680, @McgAtom, @obviyus, and @DonnieFi.
  • Files editor: Detect workspace replacement before accepting an existing editor draft, retaining the draft rather than overwriting the new workspace. #178336, #178310 Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • Gateway shutdown and restart: Prepare configuration restarts outside the restart-signal fence and keep completed command outcomes when Gateway shutdown fails. #172777, #188891 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Provider SDK startup: Prepare host SDK imports ahead of concurrent CommonJS loads so provider setup does not race module initialization. Thanks @1052326311 and @RomneyDa.
  • Copilot runtime: Bind setup verification to installed SDK and native-runtime bytes, and dispose detached native sessions without removing caller-owned conversations. Thanks @lifuyue and @RomneyDa.
  • Rollback snapshots: Preserve the prior pre-update rollback snapshot when its replacement cannot be fully written. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @kaguranananana.
  • Compaction and transcript fidelity: Keep history when a summary reaches its output limit, preserve exceptional transcript values without truncation, and confine NUL normalization to search projections. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @RomneyDa, @jondihaynes, @ylcn91, and @obviyus.
  • OpenShell workspace sync: Exclude nested repository metadata from mirror synchronization. #196747 Thanks @mmaps.
  • Telegram inline controls: Route agent-created button taps back as typed callback data, including slash-prefixed values, after offering them to plugins; keep command controls separate. #196217, #126950 Thanks @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @obviyus, and @kkernan.
  • Channel responsiveness: Avoid Gateway freezes during long Slack reasoning streams when streaming is disabled and when tool progress labels contain deep paths followed by spaces. #196250, #196249, #196282 Thanks @ptu-gh, @obviyus, and @LeizhenZhang.
  • Background replies: Deliver session-targeted cron and system-event responses, load requester capabilities for completion handoff, and stop suspended descendants from blocking finished child announcements. #196750, #196749, #197434, #197323, #197305 Thanks @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @holgergruenhagen, @wr-web, and @xRyann2255.
  • Finished child cleanup: Release retained memory when non-announcing subagents finish. #196672 Authored by @steipete.
  • Conversation continuity: Keep active turns running across automatic idle or daily session rollover and restore canonical context during retained-history reconstruction. #197345, #197324, #194362 Thanks @Jo2234, @obviyus, @abacha, @rabsef-bicrym, and @jalehman.
  • Conversation navigation: Keep touch-screen session links clear of row actions and prevent internal heartbeat wakes from becoming automatic conversation titles. #194840, #179219 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @najef1979-code and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Gateway readiness: Ignore sandbox-writable legacy workspace markers in global readiness while retaining the local fail-closed guard and Doctor diagnostics. #197248 Thanks @mmaps.
  • Database port recovery: Rerun destination owner admission to certify a resumed database copy as successful; preserve its artifacts when admission fails. #194595, #194518 Thanks @ylcn91 and @reisball.
  • Doctor disk usage: Inspect an exclusively owned, drained agent database in place instead of copying it solely to read it, retaining snapshot fallback when required. #196346 Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Audit archive recovery: Continue Doctor repairs with a warning when a checkpointed raw archive has no unimported records and its sanitized companion is missing; retain the archive and refuse recovery if unimported records remain. #186998, #186974 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @AlyaKoni.
  • Private recovery captures: Restore private permissions on installation-owned Doctor capture roots after an fsGroup remount, without changing shared-volume ownership or accepting unsafe roots. #194307, #192959 Thanks @tssala23 and @sallyom.
  • Update recovery configuration: Keep the stricter recovery configuration when combining retained and restored settings. #196474 Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Split-install guidance: Explain which installation an update targets and provide actionable guidance when Doctor repairs are blocked. #196342, #196321 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @DonnieFi.
  • Plugin lifecycle lease: Renew the plugin lifecycle lease from the existing worker heartbeat during update finalization, Doctor, and plugin installation so a stalled parent cannot expire it; keep cancellation and live-owner checks intact. The runtime holding the lease must include this fix. #188404 Authored by @steipete.
  • Large-store recovery: Select active orphan candidates in the session worker without materializing unrelated retained summaries, and start plugins and their services before the scan; channels, startup hooks, and RPC readiness still wait for recovery. #176737, #181289, #181090 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @oxen-horse.
  • Retained plugin work: Keep retained plugin capture custody and prepared lease invocation authority after the parent ends, preserving sibling permissions; relinquish predecessor invocation custody for queued replies. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Busy plugin reloads: Defer busy config reloads ahead of admission fencing, keep the original plugin drain failure on retry, and isolate service startup from its caller. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Memory provider shutdown: Drain unresolved memory managers before retiring their provider, while retaining known unaffected adapters. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Windows recovery paths: Recognize retained Windows scope aliases and keep short-path module identity during update recovery. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Session cleanup: Preserve enabled automation bindings during cleanup. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Older database repair: Limit predicate repair to supported schemas while preparing the older media schema prerequisite. Thanks @RomneyDa.

title: openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.4
summary:
2026.11.5-beta.4

Highlights

Changes

  • Telegram widgets: Render interactive widgets as Telegram messages (#196991) Thanks @obviyus.

Fixes

  • Transcripts and attachments: Keep transcript reads available during concurrent database preparation, release completed SQLite readers without restarting cursors, and avoid inserting binary attachments into model prompts (#188055, #190242, #198309, #198289) Thanks @jalehman, @vincentkoc, @ava-perry, @Yun-0000, @obviyus, and @mulderp82.
  • Automation continuity: Deliver failed-child results after parent turns end, run late scheduled jobs correctly, preserve in-flight jobs across config changes, and let repair turns inspect their jobs (#197658, #197484, #197606, #197591, #188105) Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @Stronggenetics, and @wupingyuan81-oss.
  • Automation privacy: Recheck owner-private memory access when queued automation runs start (#198697, #198695) Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Claude and approvals: Recover after CLI cleanup failures, preserve paired-node Gateway context, relay approvals across differing tool-call IDs, and allow configured-primary fallback (#198224, #195431, #145741, #145636, #197853, #197829, #198427, #158421) Thanks @obviyus, @mdarapour, @ZengWen-DT, @bricelb, @gulagala001, @Borekobama, @alkor2000, and @HerbertHuerto.
  • Provider recovery: Recover OpenAI conversations from compaction item conflicts and saved-context hook overrides, retry newer Claude models with a compatible OAuth client version, and keep OpenRouter requests on their endpoint (#198357, #199451, #196693, #185294, #185272) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, and @vishnusenthil-16.
  • Update safety: Retry installation discovery, retain run watching across ledger failures, keep plugin lifecycle leases alive during finalization, roll back releases that fail Doctor or startup, and handle moved cron partitions (#188010, #188015, #188404, #197851, #185097) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Large session memory: Export memory in bounded pages, finish large-index rebuilds after updates, and avoid unnecessary transcript allocation for native context seeds (#196158, #196132, #196480, #196378, #194545) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, and @garrytan.
  • Telegram: Deliver inline button taps, keep disabled buttons inactive, preserve topics for approvals and widgets, and include runtime session keys in message hooks (#196217, #126950, #191647, #191645, #198038, #197907, #192162, #125166, #198022, #197923, #197519, #197186, #197669) Thanks @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @obviyus, @kkernan, @aspalagin, @dankarization, @claxman, @Waste2Time, @lester076, @rodricksz4h5, and @tommyjoseph.
  • Mobile and voice: Deliver captioned Feishu media when block streaming is disabled, avoid the iOS speech-permission crash, and start backing agents for Talk requests (#191585, #196822, #183586) Thanks @forrystudio, @obviyus, @bdjben, and @brokemac79.
  • Control UI: Prevent retained loading animations from slowing repeated session switches, avoid WebKit picker/menu freezes, and handle chat Details updates without listener errors (#194027, #194146, #198658, #198380) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Gateway resilience: Bound Matrix formatted-message mention parsing, cancel pending MCP listener work during shutdown, and restore Bonjour discovery in npm installations (#184432, #197119, #199156) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, @zeroaltitude, and @alfredjbclaw.
  • Database recovery and backups: Compact backups inside staging, inspect engines without copying live databases, preserve corruption diagnostics, avoid repeated report rewrites, restore renamed-agent cold transcripts, and isolate retained or held agent databases without blocking startup (#194230, #194208, #194234, #194209, #194497, #194636, #194621, #196079, #196066, #198145, #190875, #190918, #198180) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @GoatInAHat, @wr-web, @sennyhoney, @chrislro, and @Frosmans.
  • Model selection: Avoid slow model reads with many configured models (#198837) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Automation chat bindings: Keep stored automations attached to conversations through edits, branches, and resets, while visibly refusing delivery to closed chats. Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @RomneyDa.
  • Compaction memory: Bound summary payload ownership and release source data before summaries finish so concurrent sessions do not retain entire transcripts. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Rescue diagnostics: Return completed rescue-command findings instead of losing their output. Thanks @wr-web, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Memory export completion: Settle streamed export observers after source validation. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

title: openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.3
summary:
2026.11.5-beta.3

Highlights

  • Large-session reliability: reduce memory pressure during transcript indexing, trimming, and compaction; stream only selected hydration payloads and honor configurable summary limits. (#194099, #194066, #194536, #196207) Thanks @vincentkoc, @aniruddhaadak80, @RomneyDa, @garrytan.
  • Restart and delivery safety: preserve queued-message permission ceilings and accepted ingress during restarts, drain final chat writes before handoff, and retain delivery ownership through the final RPC. (#196540, #196923, #196493, #197427) Thanks @joshavant, @vincentkoc.
  • Recovery and setup: improve cold-start initialization, interrupted workspace recovery, installer permissions, and actionable iMessage Automation status. (#192552, #196423, #186782, #186117) Thanks @javiermv, @anmol0b, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc.

Changes

  • Models and tools: restore context-sized default output budgets, expose effective deferred MCP tools with bounded input hints, and deduplicate wrapped structured MCP results. (#193899, #196766, #196252, #196266, #196243) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @GrahamMcBain, @VACInc, @vincentkoc.
  • Compaction: support a configurable summary-character limit while retaining foreground request-budget constraints and redacting credentials in quoted summary content. (#196207, #197349) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @RomneyDa, @garrytan, @obviyus.
  • Browser and workspaces: route Lightpanda navigation through its supported connection path and wait for sandbox files to become ready. (#196400, #197248) Thanks @RomneyDa, @mmaps.

Fixes

  • Startup and updates: retry transient shared-state schema admission, defer cold-start runtime initialization, preserve external-plugin data during update rehearsals, keep idle cron workers disabled, and split timed-out SQLite header probes. Conflicting legacy exec-approval files no longer prevent startup; canonical policy remains authoritative. (#195398, #192552, #196301, #196387, #193970, #194239, #196401) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc.
  • Sessions and storage: bound large-transcript indexing and trimming, stream selected compaction payloads, exclude consumed inputs from actor hydration, and recover cold PostgreSQL conversations after readers close. Preserve active turns across session rollover, settle suspended descendants, and repair persisted internal-wake titles. (#194099, #194066, #194536, #196277, #189991, #197345, #197323, #196362) Thanks @vincentkoc, @etzelm, @Jo2234, @obviyus, @abacha, @wr-web, @xRyann2255, @RomneyDa.
  • Authority and delivery: require effective authority for delegated changes, apply input-policy hooks to prepared images, preserve accepted queued ingress and original permissions through restart, and wait for final writes within the existing restart budget. Keep final-delivery ownership until its RPC settles. (#196984, #196337, #196923, #196540, #196493, #197427) Thanks @joshavant, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa.
  • Execution and progress: collect process results at suspended capacity, retain accepted ClawHub attempts after timeouts, settle failed Code Mode calls without unresolved sibling waits, and detect silent model streams despite tool heartbeats. Bound silent Agents API startup and release retained completion authority for finished non-announcing children. (#196927, #196929, #196435, #196517, #196672) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Channels: retain iMessage Automation warnings until an accepted send, avoid Slack reasoning-stream freezes, handle empty IRC channel sender lists, and preserve local final replies in history. Cron and system replies no longer use closed plugin scopes. (#186117, #196250, #196293, #187795, #196750) Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @RomneyDa, @mmaps, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ptu-gh.
  • Provider setup: retain Z.ai Coding Plan catalog models, deduplicate concurrent provider-catalog imports, preserve model API billing settings during config writes, recover cancelled Claude CLI login refreshes, and omit enums from non-string Gemini parameter schemas. (#195390, #196448, #191326, #197032, #196742) Thanks @jason-allen-oneal, @1052326311, @WG-Mojo, @etzelm, @obviyus, @kir1ll, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa.
  • Diagnostics: avoid repeated redaction and serialization during opt-in OpenTelemetry content capture, bound oversized image capture, and redact raw multiline strings before JSON escaping. (#186666, #194353) Thanks @651juan, @amittell, @mmaps.
  • Platform recovery: compare Windows state paths case-insensitively, respect installer permission masks, and recover macOS LaunchAgents when Trash access is denied. Keep iOS gateway recovery reachable while reconnecting and remove legacy plaintext setup-code preferences; pasted setup codes stay in memory. (#185917, #186782, #189321, #191560, #197049) Thanks @YangManBOBO, @javiermv, @sukhdeepjohar, @obviyus, @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc.
  • Workspace and database recovery: recover interrupted workspace turns, avoid false admission after resumed database copies, and keep stopped-database Doctor inspection read-only on full disks. Open nested repositories outside mirror paths correctly. (#196423, #194595, #196346, #196747) Thanks @mmaps, @ylcn91, @reisball, @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Interface and release routing: keep session links and row actions usable on touch devices, avoid freezes from deep-path progress labels, and reject incompatible release routes. (#194840, #196282, #196878) Thanks @RomneyDa, @najef1979-code, @vyctorbrzezowski, @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.5-beta.2..7f4704e history: 50 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 50 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

title: v2.1.325
summary:
What's changed

  • Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded
  • Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook
  • Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run /rewind and change the message, or run /clear
  • Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed git checkout, git stash or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in .claude
  • Fixed /security-review and skills' inline git commands stopping with an error in worktrees of bare repositories, --separate-git-dir checkouts and Android repo checkouts
  • Fixed subagents with their own model being moved to the plan-mode model when the model setting is opusplan or haiku
  • Fixed subagents on a different model sizing file reads and MCP results with the main session's model
  • Fixed sessions on many third-party gateways and Foundry stopping with a context length error on every turn instead of compacting
  • Fixed recent turns sometimes going missing from a resumed session after Claude Code stopped without a clean exit
  • Fixed shell commands running in the launch directory after the working directory was deleted; the command now fails with a message and can be re-issued
  • Fixed an approved plan edit being lost when the plansDirectory folder can't take it: the plan is now saved in the default plans folder, and a warning says where and why
  • Fixed a saved sonnet[1m] model setting being rewritten on a new install to a model id the API rejects
  • Fixed focus view hiding the reply to your prompt when a scheduled task replied after it
  • Fixed the prompt sometimes missing from a background subagent's view when fullscreen is off
  • Fixed long options in lists and permission prompts being partly overwritten when they wrap, and first-run screens losing lines on narrow terminals
  • Fixed startup warnings about permission rules and the "N MCP servers need authentication" notice being recorded as seen when they were scrolled out of view
  • Fixed the welcome header showing control characters or splitting across lines when an agent's name or the working folder contains them or a line break
  • Fixed the red error shown when Claude tries a command only you can run: a dim line now says it runs only when you type it at the prompt
  • Fixed /stats showing an Active days total that was one day too high
  • Fixed /insights saying a report was ready when no session qualified for analysis, and writing two values into its HTML report without escaping them
  • Fixed /voice saying voice mode changed when managed settings, --settings, or the project's .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json kept it as it was; it now says what holds it
  • Fixed the IDE welcome dialog showing Cmd+Esc for Quick Launch on Windows and Linux
  • Fixed Slack app tips showing when your organization's policy denies cloud sessions
  • Fixed claude purge hanging silently when there is no terminal to read keys from, and its project picker and -i prompts ignoring the keyboard when stdin is piped
  • Fixed claude plugin eval --output-dir '' writing the report into the current folder; it now exits with an error
  • Fixed claude -p text output on a terminal passing control sequences other than text styling; pipes and files are unchanged
  • Fixed leftover .oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.* files piling up in the config directory
  • Fixed /fast saying "Fast mode has been disabled by your organization" under the keyless Console sign-in, where Claude Code had not asked the server
  • Fixed /model saying that your organization restricts a model when Claude Code could not check that, for example with no network
  • Fixed "Sign in with your Console account" in /login replacing your existing login when you pressed Esc right after the browser step
  • Fixed the browser showing the sign-in success page in some cases where sign-in failed or was canceled
  • Fixed claude auth status and other short commands leaving a lock behind on a Console profile, which made the next session hang for about a minute
  • Fixed background sessions started on your claude.ai login using (and billing) an API key or token from the shell that started the background service
  • Fixed more cases of a session moving to another sign-in in the background; these moves are now refused, with a message saying what works
  • Fixed a second Enter in the exit dialog stopping background work after the move to the background was refused
  • Fixed token counting on Amazon Bedrock sending the conversation to Bedrock when the allowedProviders managed setting does not allow it
  • Fixed AWS credential_process helpers and Google Cloud default credentials failing when Claude Code is started without a HOME environment variable
  • Fixed a session sometimes going back to an earlier permission mode after a subagent's plan was approved
  • Fixed one invalid value in an Agent SDK applyFlagSettings() call silently discarding all settings from earlier calls; a call that would do this is now refused with an error
  • Fixed sessions showing as waiting for input when a finished pull request only needed your own review or merge
  • Fixed an unrecognized teammateMode settings value being ignored without a warning: claude -p, the startup warning and claude doctor now list it as a skipped entry (still not applied)
  • Fixed --worktree skipping a WorktreeCreate hook from a plugin in CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR on the first run in a new home directory
  • Fixed brief-mode sessions, such as Dispatch, sending a reply again after the turn had already replied
  • Fixed Claude saying a working Atlassian, Asana or Sentry connector had failed in cloud sessions when a plugin listed it at a different URL
  • Fixed Claude Desktop and SDK sessions listing a folder's own MCP servers (.mcp.json, local) as host-added or not at all, and not connecting WebSocket ones, after a folder move or pre-warmed start
  • Fixed /mcp still listing a plugin's MCP server after a plugin reload removed it while it was connecting
  • Fixed an MCP server staying "needs authentication", and its mcp_tool hooks being skipped, after a token refresh that was refused only for a moment
  • Fixed MCP elicitation requests being cancelled without asking in headless mode after a server's connection was replaced during a tool call
  • Fixed MCP tool calls from an SDK host answering "Not connected" after a tool call had reconnected the MCP server
  • Fixed an MCP task getting stuck after its question was closed with Esc or asked again: the footer now says it needs your input, and Enter in /tasks shows the question again
  • Fixed background MCP tasks that stopped updating after another call to the same server lost the connection, when a later call reconnects
  • Fixed a background MCP task's question opening over a message you were still typing; it now waits until you send or clear the draft, and the spinner and turn timer keep running
  • Fixed worktree.sparsePaths and sparse plugin and marketplace clones leaving out the repository's root files on older git versions, such as 2.34
  • Fixed self-hosted runner sessions with several repositories being unable to use a repository added mid-session
  • Fixed Claude asking for permission before reading your own artifact or its data
  • Fixed deny and ask permission rules and hooks for the Artifact tool not applying in some cloud sessions
  • Fixed Code Mode scripts ignoring a worktree entered with EnterWorktree, writing ~ paths into the project, and leaving /mcp showing an MCP server as connected after its sign-in expired
  • Fixed words typed with a Yes at a permission dialog or plan approval not reaching Claude in Code Mode
  • Fixed Claude starting work by itself when you resumed a session that ended during a Code Mode script; it now waits for your next prompt
  • Fixed a missing OpenTelemetry user_prompt event for a message sent while tool calls run. The event has delivery.mode: "mid_turn" and the running turn's prompt.id
  • Fixed the OpenTelemetry user_prompt event leaving out earlier messages' text when queued messages merged into one turn in VS Code, or when one message had an image
  • Fixed a slash command's allowed-tools grants applying to background agents woken during or after its turn
  • Fixed /feedback and /bug to upload other sessions only when they were recorded by the signed-in account or organization
  • Fixed relative deny and ask permission rules (e.g. Read(./.env)) no longer covering the project after a cd; they now also apply in added directories
  • Fixed deny and ask permission rules starting with mcp__plugin_*_ missing a plugin's MCP server or tool spelled in another letter case
  • Fixed deny rules not being applied to a permission approval that arrives after Claude Code restarts, in self-hosted runner and claude remote-control sessions
  • Fixed a case where a committed .claude/settings.local.json could be treated as the user's own when Claude Code was started in certain subfolders of a repository
  • Fixed some deny and ask rules not applying to certain Bash commands
  • Fixed a gap in Bash permission checks where some compound commands could run without asking; these now ask for permission
  • Fixed a case where a Bash allow rule could run a different program than the one it names
  • Fixed a connector tool's approval prompt in cloud sessions being answered automatically while plugins were still loading
  • Fixed some subagents changing an artifact that people outside your organization can see, or uploading files to it, without asking first when an allow rule is set or uploads were approved earlier
  • Fixed some artifact publishes skipping the confirmation for pages that people outside your organization can see when "don't ask again" had been chosen for Artifact
  • Fixed auto mode judging only the first change to an artifact that people outside your organization can see; its yes now covers that change alone
  • Fixed a managed strictPluginOnlyCustomization lock on agents and skills not taking effect in sessions that were already running
  • Fixed sandboxed commands being able to write to the native updater's download folder in some cases
  • Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a worktree's settings and hooks
  • Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a linked worktree's shared git folder
  • Fixed /teleport's stash choice in some unusual git states: it now stops and says what to do
  • Windows: Fixed a start-up stall that could last about a second when a PATH entry sits under a folder your account cannot open
  • Fixed /resume on Windows refusing or hiding sessions whose folder was recorded with a different drive-letter case or slashes
  • Fixed an in-session /resume on Windows dropping a project's saved trust when the session was recorded with a different drive-letter case
  • Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with bwrap: Can't create file when the working directory was below an allowRead folder inside a denyRead, such as under a symlinked home directory
  • Fixed Claude Desktop's third-party deployments staying on "Stopping" until a token renewal finished (once it includes this version)
  • Improved subagents cut off at the output token limit: they are now asked for the whole answer again, more briefly, instead of returning only its end
  • Improved startup with a keyless Console sign-in or other Anthropic profile login: a token that is still valid is read without waiting for the credentials lock
  • Improved the account email check: it now also refuses your email as a client's identity in scripts a command runs, file writes, web fetches and MCP calls
  • Improved the HTTPS authentication failed message for private plugin marketplaces: it now says git's terminal prompts and askpass programs are disabled, and it also appears with newer git versions
  • Improved the add-marketplace confirmations, plugin recommendation prompts and plugin install warning to say that plugins can run code on your computer, with access to your files and shell
  • Improved the claude --desktop sign-in error to name the API key, provider or setting that stops a Claude account sign-in from working
  • Improved the /voice "No audio detected" message on macOS and Windows: it now says where to pick your microphone
  • Improved MCP tasks: Claude is now told when a task is waiting for your answer, and can point you to /tasks
  • Improved claude remote-control: it now exits with status 4 when it stops by itself (single-session runs still exit 0) and 69 when it can't register, so a service manager can start it again
  • Improved the messages shown when a background session can't use its session's API key or token: they no longer suggest adding the key to settings
  • Improved the bundled dataviz skill's part-to-whole advice for static images and for parts with a natural order, such as age bands
  • Changed sandboxed Bash commands to follow the normal permission flow by default; set sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true to keep running them without prompts
  • Changed managed settings that turn the sandbox on: to keep commands running without prompts, set sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true in your highest-ranking managed source
  • Changed read-only git commands to ask first in a repository that isn't the project's or one you trusted; name it with --add-dir, not the additionalDirectories setting, to run them without prompts
  • Changed scheduled tasks and /loop to ask before running a skill that declares allowed-tools or hooks; add Skill(name) to permissions.allow to run it unattended
  • Changed "Always allow" in Desktop, IDE and SDK hosts: a rule alone is offered only when saving it would allow that command again, so a scheduled task that relied on one can now wait for you
  • Changed the sandbox to refuse sandboxed writes to .claude settings, skills, agents, commands and hooks in added directories, as it does in the launch folder
  • Changed worktree isolation: an isolated worktree session or agent is now refused git bisect run, git maintenance register|start and scalar's set-up commands, and is told what still works
  • Changed plugin MCP bundles (.mcpb, .dxt) to unpack under the plugins directory, not .mcpb-cache in the plugin's folder, so read-only plugin folders load; one fetched by URL downloads again once
  • Changed plugins of a remote marketplace that managed settings declare, enable and list in prependPlugins or appendPlugins to count as the organization's; pluginDigests is deprecated and ignored
  • Changed plugin loading to skip, and claude plugin validate to report, some unsafe paths and links in a plugin's folder
  • Changed nested skill loading: .claude/skills folders in --plugin-dir plugins no longer load from a session started above them; start Claude Code in the plugin folder instead
  • Changed EnterWorktree to refuse a WorktreeCreate hook path that goes through a symlink inside the project; have the hook print the real path
  • Changed tmux and iTerm2 teammates, and new sessions from the agents view opened with ←, to start in the session's folder instead of where the shell last ran cd
  • Changed prompt suggestions in the terminal to refresh less often after 8 turns in a row started by background or scheduled tasks, saving usage until you press a key or return to the terminal
  • Changed Esc on a background MCP task's question to "answer later": nothing is sent to the server, and the question stays in /tasks
  • Changed CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS to also set the context window of unrecognized model IDs that start with claude-, such as a gateway's claude-sonnet-latest
  • Changed /login to ask for permission to change your privacy settings
  • Changed /cost, $.session.usage(), --max-budget-usd and the cost and token metrics to count a mod's $.model.complete and $.model.classify calls
  • Changed the programs that Claude Code's sandbox starts for its own use, such as its network bridge, to run without Claude Code's sign-in tokens and API keys in their environment
  • Changed ripgrep, local git commands and the sandbox runtime's own helper programs to run without the mTLS client key's passphrase in their environment
  • Remote Control: Changed /resume and /teleport to disconnect first when the connected session has a share link, or when that can't be checked; run /remote-control to connect again
  • Changed Claude Code on the web, cloud scheduled tasks and Cowork cloud sessions to start despite sandbox.failIfUnavailable: the hosted container has no command sandbox
  • Changed requests for settings, permission rules, hooks or status over a cloud or self-hosted session's connection to return less or be refused; what applies in the session is unchanged
  • Changed claude -p with no cached account data to wait for that data before its first request, so a first run in a clean environment can start a few seconds later
  • Changed Claude's instructions to keep files you'll want out of its temporary scratchpad folder, which can be cleared
  • Changed marketplace ref to accept the full ID of any commit on a branch or tag; clients before this version can't clone such a pin, so a marketplace pinned this way stops loading there
  • Changed plugin marketplace and plugin downloads to use a CONNECT tunnel when ALL_PROXY is the only proxy set; a proxy that refuses CONNECT now fails them
  • Changed -p and SDK runs in a worktree or submodule mounted into a container to apply .claude/settings.local.json allow rules only once the folder is trusted
  • Changed self-hosted runners to refuse a session whose session folder or repository path is a symbolic link, other than a checkout hook's checkout
  • Removed "ask your admin to raise it" from spend limit and shared budget errors in cloud sessions and under Remote Control
  • [VSCode] Added prompt suggestions wherever the terminal shows them: Tab accepts the suggested next prompt; promptSuggestionEnabled: false in Claude Code's settings.json turns them off
  • [VSCode] Added a Console sign-in that creates no API key
  • [VSCode] Added a field to paste the redirect URL when signing in to an MCP server from the panel in SSH, WSL and container windows
  • [VSCode] Fixed the model picker's check mark staying on the old model after Claude Code restarted on another model or the model was switched over Remote Control
  • [VSCode] Fixed the effort selector offering levels above the effort cap set by your organization or the maxEffortLevel setting
  • [VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen offering sign-ins that the managed allowedProviders setting refuses
  • [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for MCP tools not saying why Claude Code asks when a safety check raises the question
  • [VSCode] Fixed the message for organization settings that couldn't load saying to run a command again; it now says to try again, matching the tab's Retry link
  • [VSCode] Improved the note shown for an untrusted folder: it now says why the extension is off and how to turn it on
  • [VSCode] Improved the error shown when the system refuses to run Claude Code: it now says your IT team can allow a blocked program
  • [VSCode] Improved the sign-in card to say what to do when the browser shows a connection error for localhost
  • [VSCode] Changed the install link's marketplace confirmation button to "Trust marketplace and continue"
  • [Claude Code on the web] Fixed new cloud sessions cutting MCP tool descriptions loaded through tool search at 4,096 characters; the limit is now 16,384, as in other Claude Code sessions
  • [Claude Tag] Fixed artifact links pasted in Slack getting no card when the poster's Claude sign-in had expired in a workspace their organization doesn't manage; a plain card now appears

title: Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0
summary:
🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

🚀 What's New in v1.0

Simplified Configuration

  • Automatic mode detection - No more manual mode configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
  • Unified interface - All prompts now go through a single prompt input, and all CLI options through claude_args
  • Better SDK alignment - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

More Powerful & Flexible

  • Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through claude_args
  • Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
  • Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:

  • mode, direct_prompt, override_prompt → unified prompt input
  • custom_instructions, model, allowed_tools, mcp_config → claude_args with CLI format
  • Other deprecated: disallowed_tools, anthropic_model, trigger_phrase, timeout_minutes

📚 Please review our Migration Guide for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.

💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

  • Automated PR Reviews - Intelligent code review on every pull request
  • CI Failure Fixes - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
  • Issue Triage - Smart categorization and response to new issues
  • Documentation Generation - Keep docs in sync with code changes
  • Security Scanning - Proactive vulnerability detection
  • And many more!

🔧 Check out all examples at github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples

🏃 Quick Start

# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10

📖 Resources

  • Migration Guide - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
  • Examples - Ready-to-use workflow templates
  • Documentation - Complete setup and configuration guide

🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!
